authorization: Same user-adopted bounded read-only investigation as INFO_01; four successful metadata responses are prerequisite.
stop: first HTTP/transport/schema failure, physical rows greater than per, or cap; no next page or retry
transport: same curl stdin credential handling; serial; 10 s connect / 30 s request / 10 MiB response / no redirect
retention: counts, technical paths, types, nullability and sampled distinct cardinalities; no values, IDs, hashes of IDs, raw bodies or URLs
recovery: append-only reservation/outcome ledger; a lost outcome is unknown and must never be retried automatically
